messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
वह उसे हर गाँव में शिकार करेगा, जब तक वह उसे नर्क में वापस रख देगा, वहाँ जहाँ ईर्ष्या ने उसे पहली बार भेजा।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Questi | male agent (subject) | वह | “he” | OK | | la | female patient (object) | उसे | “her” | OK | | caccerà | future “hunt” (verb) | शिकार करेगा | “will hunt” | OK | | per | preposition “through/over” (traversal) | में | “in” (as part of “हर गाँव में”) | OK | | ogne | quantifier “every” | हर | “every” | OK | | villa | “town, village” | गाँव | “town” | OK | | fin | subordinating conjunction “until” | जब तक | “until” | OK | | che | complementizer (part of “until … that”) | — (absorbed in “जब तक”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | l’avrà | future auxiliary “shall have” | देगा | “will give/shall” (future) | WRONG (does not convey perfect aspect) | | rimessa | past‑participle “set back” | रख | “put/keep” | WRONG (missing “back” and perfect nuance) | | ne | preposition “in” (locative) | में | “in” | OK | | lo | masculine singular article (definite) | — (no article in Hindi) | — | UNNECESSARY | | ’nferno | “hell” (destination) | नर्क | “hell” | OK | | là | adverb of place “there” | वहाँ | “there” | OK | | onde | relative adverb “whence/where” | जहाँ | “where/whence” | OK | | ’nvidia | personified “envy” | ईर्ष्या | “envy” | OK | | prima | temporal qualifier “first” | पहली बार | “first time” | OK | | dipartilla | future “send forth” (verb + clitic) | भेजा | “sent” (past) | WRONG (tense should be future “भेजेगा”) |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **WRONG**: - *l’avrà* → “देगा” (does not express the future‑perfect “shall have set back”). - *rimessa* → “रख” (lacks the “back” notion and perfect aspect). - *dipartilla* → “भेजा” (past tense; should be future “भेजेगा”).
- **UNNECESSARY**: - *che* (its function is merged into “जब तक”). - *lo* (definite article not needed in Hindi).
All other source words are adequately rendered in the Hindi translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: वह उसे हर गाँव में शिकार करेगा, - Issue: none - Corrected: वह उसे हर गाँव में शिकार करेगा,
- Line 2: - Original: जब तक वह उसे नर्क में वापस रख देगा, - Issue: WRONG – future‑perfect aspect missing - Corrected: जब तक वह उसे नर्क में वापस रख चुका होगा,
- Line 3: - Original: वहाँ जहाँ ईर्ष्या ने उसे पहली बार भेजा। - Issue: WRONG – tense should be future - Corrected: वहाँ जहाँ ईर्ष्या ने उसे पहली बार भेजेगा।
```text वह उसे हर गाँव में शिकार करेगा, जब तक वह उसे नर्क में वापस रख चुका होगा, वहाँ जहाँ ईर्ष्या ने उसे पहली बार भेजेगा। ```
